# `auth.oidc.callback`

Finish an OIDC login

Consumes single-use state, exchanges the code with PKCE, verifies nonce, and signs the user in.

- Method and path: `GET /login/oidc/{provider}/callback`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie auth oidc callback`
- MCP: `auth_oidc_callback`

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | query | no | `string` |
| `provider` | path | yes | `string` |
| `state` | query | no | `string` |

## Errors

`conflict`, `forbidden`, `not-found`, `unauthorized`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
